purpose: Define each planned production-affecting configuration, deployment, network, secret, migration or lifecycle change as an explicit change identity.

topics.name: Operational Change Identity
topics.purpose: Define each planned production-affecting configuration, deployment, network, secret, migration or lifecycle change as an explicit change identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each operational change has an explicit identity.
semantics.rollback_rule: Rollback/recovery plan is explicit where applicable.
semantics.schedule_rule: Change window/timing is explicit where required.
semantics.authority_rule: Change record does not authorize execution by itself.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
